findings.title: Call to undefined isConditionalPasskeysEnabled()
findings.body: UsernameForm.authenticate calls isConditionalPasskeysEnabled() with no arguments, but the changed UsernamePasswordForm only defines isConditionalPasskeysEnabled(UserModel). No no-argument version is shown in UsernameForm, UsernamePasswordForm, or AbstractUsernameFormAuthenticator. As provided, this will not compile; if the intent was to check whether passkeys are enabled for the realm/user, the corresponding method is missing or the call is wrong.

findings.title: Conditional passkeys are disabled when no user is known
findings.body: isConditionalPasskeysEnabled(UserModel) returns false when user is null, and authenticate()/challenge() call it with context.getUser(). Conditional passkeys are expected to be available on the initial login form before a user is identified, so this prevents webauthnAuth.fillContextForm() from running on first login or after invalid-username errors. That removes the passkey/conditional UI from the initial login page and contradicts the updated tests that expect the webauth form before username entry.

findings.title: shouldDisplayAuthenticators not disabled for conditional UI
findings.body: WebAuthnConditionalUIAuthenticator overrides shouldShowWebAuthnAuthenticators() to false so authenticators are not listed, but it does not override shouldDisplayAuthenticators(). During re-authentication context.getUser() is non-null, so WebAuthnAuthenticator.fillContextForm() will set SHOULD_DISPLAY_AUTHENTICATORS to true while not setting ALLOWED_AUTHENTICATORS. This can cause the login template to display or expect an authenticator list that the conditional UI intentionally suppresses.

findings.title: Broad exception catch can hide unexpected test failures
findings.body: The test catches Exception when checking that the webauth form is absent. This swallows any unexpected runtime failure (wrong page, stale element, unexpected Selenium error, etc.) and treats it as the expected absence of the element. It should catch NoSuchElementException specifically, here and in the similar block around line 315.
